newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Net sales of 66,500 MT were down 42 percent from the previous week and 31 percent below the 4-week average. The major buyers were Japan (39,500 MT) and Mexico (26,700 MT).

Exports of 90,200 MT were down 18 percent from the week earlier and 34 percent from the 4-week average. Mexico (27,900 MT) was the primary destination, followed by Japan (24,000 MT), Israel (20,900 MT), and Spain (17,400 MT).
